neighbours.label: ' meet' (and the 'to' before it) in 'meet the needs / demand / requirements / targets', i.e. satisfying a requirement; 'meet' as encountering a person stays quiet.
fire: The factory added a shift to meet rising demand.
The plan does not meet safety standards.
Schools must meet the needs of every pupil.
The firm failed to meet its sales targets.
The hospital hired nurses to meet the requirements.
Supply cannot meet demand this winter.
The design meets all building codes.
We worked late to meet the deadline.
quiet: The factory added a shift after the holidays.
The plan was written by the safety team.
Schools must teach every pupil to read.
The firm hired a new sales manager.
The hospital hired nurses from abroad.
We will meet our cousins at the airport.
The designers meet every Monday for coffee.
We worked late and met friends afterwards.

notes: Card: ' meet' x18, ' to' x4, ' up' x2, ' meeting', ' keep', ' suffice' (needed to⟦ meet⟧ the needs of 98%); output promotes ' meet', ' demand', ' satisfy', ' fulfill'. Exploratory probe: 'to meet demand' 1.05, 'to meet the needs' 0.49; 'to meet her sister' 0.04. Near misses include 'meet' with people.
